title: Transcriptomic profiles of resected 50 pancreatic adenocarcinoma samples
author: Bouchart, Christelle
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Extract RNA from FFPE tissue
steps.instruction: Scrape the FFPE tissue sections and extract RNA using the ALLPrep FFPE Tissue Kit (Qiagen) on the Qiacube semi‑automated instrument according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Run the extracted RNA on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer with the RNA 6000 Pico LabChip kit and analyze the electropherograms using Agilent 2100 Expert Software to obtain DV200 values and concentration.

substeps.instruction: Run RNA on Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using RNA 6000 Pico LabChip kit
Analyze electropherograms with Agilent 2100 Expert Software to determine DV200 and concentration

steps.title: Select and normalize RNA
steps.instruction: Select RNA samples with DV200 > 30 % and normalize each to 100 ng for library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare NGS libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries using the QuantSeq Library Prep Kit for Illumina (Lexogen) following the manufacturer’s recommendations.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the libraries onto a NovaSeq 6000 and sequence using the NovaSeq 6000 S2 Reagent Kit with 100 bp single‑end reads.

substeps.instruction: Run sequencing with S2 Reagent Kit, 100 bp single reads
